svg.title: An order belongs to one customer and is made of line items, each for one product
svg.desc: Class diagram. Class Customer: attributes +name: String, +email: String; operations +placeOrder(cart: Cart): Order. Class Order: attributes +number: int, +placedOn: Date; operations +total(): Money. Class LineItem: attributes +quantity: int; operations +subtotal(): Money. Class Product: attributes +sku: String, +price: Money. Class Catalog. 1 Customer places 0..* Order. 1 Order is composed of 1..* LineItem (contains). 0..* LineItem is for 1 Product. 1 Catalog has 0..* Product (lists).
